code:
SELECT s.session_id, s.login_name, s.host_name,
       s.status, s.cpu_time, c.client_net_address
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections AS c
  ON s.session_id = c.session_id
WHERE s.is_user_process = 1;
caption: is_user_process = 1 drops SQL Server's own internal sessions.

code:
SELECT TOP 60 end_time, avg_cpu_percent,
       avg_data_io_percent, avg_log_write_percent
FROM sys.dm_db_resource_stats
ORDER BY end_time DESC;
caption: One row every 15 seconds, roughly the last hour — straight T-SQL.
